description: This file is a shell library containing functions to test git credential helpers, including helper functions for registering, cleaning, and verifying credential storage, retrieval, and rejection behaviors. It includes extensive tests for various credential scenarios such as long input handling, expiry, OAuth tokens, authtype handling, and multiple user credentials.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Function to simulate credential helper interactions, reading input, executing git credential commands, and comparing output to expected values.

methods.name: read_chunk
methods.description: Reads lines from stdin until a terminator ('--') is encountered, outputting each line.

methods.name: helper_test_clean
methods.description: Clears residual credential data for various host/protocol combinations to reset the state.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Issues a credential rejection for specified protocol, host, and username.

methods.name: helper_test
methods.description: Runs a comprehensive test suite on a specified credential helper to verify storage, retrieval, overwriting, deletion, and long input handling.

methods.name: helper_test_timeout
methods.description: Tests credential helper behavior when a timeout occurs.

methods.name: helper_test_password_expiry_utc
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving password expiry timestamps.

methods.name: helper_test_oauth_refresh_token
methods.description: Tests storage and retrieval of OAuth refresh tokens.

methods.name: helper_test_authtype
methods.description: Tests handling of credentials with authtype capabilities and various credential-related parameters such as ephemeral flags.
